new_result.scope: For any symmetric full A and any selected orthonormal three-eigenvector frame with |lambda_a|>=1, every family R of physical row triples satisfies sum_{I in R,J}det(A_{I,J})^2 >= (lambda_1 lambda_2 lambda_3)^2 sum_{I in R}det(U_I)^2. Hence one column-overlap stratum q=0,1,2,3 carries at least one quarter of the selected Pluecker packet mass.

partner_result_applied.application: Nested-heavy fixed-pair Pluecker mass ch>1/4 yields full-matrix overlap energy >1/16; the eta=1/16 two-coloop branch ch>3/4 yields >3/16.

first_unproved_step: QFORM-OVERLAP-STRATUM-ANALYTIC-PAYMENT-v1: convert a constant aggregate overlap-minor energy E_q(R) into a dimension-free small-ball/density estimate without selecting one tiny minor and while preserving the original-coordinate product law; q=1,2 are the main mixed self/cross cases.
next_step: Derive a weighted original-coordinate conditioning/decoupling inequality for aggregate q=2 and q=1 overlap energy, testing first on A=I_4-J_4/3 and on the partner nested-heavy disjoint-bank normal form.
